_about: Audit data for the Paloma's flow. Each catalog piece is priced at the CAD furniture tier (small/light, medium/average, large/heavy; accents use xs-xl) judged against a typical piece of its type, per the CAD price card: Small/Light = noticeably smaller or lighter than average for the type; Medium/Average = the standard category for most items of a type; Large/Heavy = noticeably larger or heavier than average. dims = published W x D x H where the site lists them (else not listed); weight is not published by the site for any piece; maxDimIn drives the automatic stairs fee (main-site size rule); basis says how the tier was judged. Staff and clients never see tier names.
